#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long primeModulo = 1000000007;

int readInt() {
    int x; cin >> x; return x;
}

vector<char> generateDistinctChars(vector<char>& arr, int index, int count) {
    vector<bool> usedLetters(26, false);
    for (int pos = index - 1; pos >= 0 && pos >= index - count; pos--) {
        usedLetters[arr[pos] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    vector<char> result;
    char c = 'a';
    while ((int)result.size() < count) {
        if (!usedLetters[c - 'a']) {
            result.push_back(c);
        }
        c++;
    }
    return result;
}

long long calculateOverlap(int a, int b, int left, int right, vector<char>& pattern) {
    vector<char> arr(3 * (a + b));
    for (int segmentIdx = 0; segmentIdx < 3; segmentIdx++) {
        vector<char> distinctChars = generateDistinctChars(arr, segmentIdx * (a + b), a);
        for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
            arr[segmentIdx * (a + b) + i] = distinctChars[i];
        }
        for (int i = a; i < a + b; i++) {
            arr[segmentIdx * (a + b) + i] = pattern[segmentIdx];
        }
    }
    int startOffset = left % (a + b);
    int totalLength = right - left + 1;
    vector<char> subArr(arr.begin() + startOffset, arr.end());
    if ((int)subArr.size() > totalLength) {
        subArr.resize(totalLength);
    }
    vector<bool> observed(26, false);
    for (char ch : subArr) {
        observed[ch - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int totalTypes = 0;
    for (bool flag : observed) {
        if (flag) totalTypes++;
    }
    return totalTypes;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int a = readInt();
    int b = readInt();
    int l = readInt() - 1;
    int r = readInt() - 1;
    int s = r - l + 1;

    for (char ch1 = 'a'; ch1 <= 'z'; ch1++) {
        for (char ch2 = 'a'; ch2 <= 'z'; ch2++) {
            for (char ch3 = 'a'; ch3 <= 'z'; ch3++) {
                vector<char> pattern = {ch1, ch2, ch3};
                s = min(s, (int)calculateOverlap(a, b, l, r, pattern));
            }
        }
    }
    cout << s << "\n";
    return 0;
}
